subject: science
passage: The hydrologists spent three weeks ______ water samples along the Ravi River before the first monsoon rains arrived. Their data later showed that nitrate levels rose sharply in the weeks after the rains.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The verb "spent" must be followed by an -ing form that names the activity. The only option with that form is "collecting," which completes the phrase "spent three weeks collecting."
explanation.A: Incorrect. The verb "spent" is followed by an -ing form, not by "to" plus a verb. "Spent to collect" is not standard English.
explanation.B: Correct. The verb "spend" takes an -ing form when it is followed by an activity, so "spent three weeks collecting water samples" is the standard structure.
explanation.C: Incorrect. After "spent," the next verb must take the -ing form. A bare verb like "collect" does not fit the structure of the sentence.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A finite verb such as "collects" cannot follow "spent" directly. The structure needs a non-finite -ing form.
